definitions.explanation: Digging into tombs or archaeological sites to steal what is buried there. Also used for illegally digging up minerals or wild plants.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古墳|こふん}→古墳：11853_kofun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{盗掘|とうくつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The ancient burial mound was robbed.

examples.japanese: {盗掘|とうくつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: Signs of grave robbing were found.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発掘|はっくつ}→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盗掘|とうくつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}い→遭う：09500_au⟧、⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な{副葬品|ふくそうひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{失|うしな}われた→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: Many ancient sites were plundered before they could be excavated, and valuable grave goods were lost.

notes:
⟦{盗|ぬす}む→盗む：01166_nusumu⟧ (to steal) + ⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧ (to dig).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盗掘|とうくつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to be plundered
- {盗掘|とうくつ}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: grave robber, looter
- {盗掘|とうくつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent looting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発掘|はっくつ}→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧: excavation — the legitimate, scholarly dig
